description: A React component file implementing a test form for routing logic, including form rendering, route testing, and result display with support for dialogs and mobile views.

classes.name: FormView
classes.description: A React component for rendering the form input fields and footer, handling form submission and validation.

classes.name: TestForm
classes.description: Main React component for testing routing logic, managing form state, route matching, and displaying results or errors.

classes.name: TestFormRenderer
classes.description: Component for rendering the TestForm within dialogs or mobile views, managing open/close state.

methods.name: resetMembersMatchResult
methods.description: Resets the members match result state and hides results.

methods.name: testRouting
methods.description: Executes route matching and updates the UI with the matched route and possibly triggers team member matching logic.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Handles closing the form or dialog, resetting states.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets form state and forces re-rendering.
